english.summary: A strategy and card-combat game where countries can be merged and divided to reshape the map.
english.description: Strategy guides every decision: the player can reshape geography by merging and splitting countries, while a dynamic card-based combat system determines conquests and defeats. Territories are procedurally generated from GeoJSON data.
english.development:
- Designed and implemented an event bus to communicate between the game’s different systems
- Developed an AI system for enemy players
- Implemented the Command pattern for the different actions players can perform
- Learned to use VContainer as a dependency-injection framework
